newsitem.title: UK: Davies Turner adds Heathrow X-ray machine.
newsitem.headline: Davies Turner adds Heathrow X-ray machine.

text.p: Davies Turner Air Cargo said it has invested in a new large X-ray machine at its London Heathrow airfreight hub to meet tougher security regulations applying to the airfreight industry.
The new machine has a 1.5 sq metre aperture and is able to scan a full size and fully laden shipper pallet, the company said in a statement.
It added that it is one of only a handful of airfreight agents to have such equipment which meet British department of transport rules.
Davies Turner is the airfreight arm of the Davies Turner Group. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
